# Agent Instructions: Documentation Scope

## Scope & Boundaries
- **Target Context:** Only read and modify source Markdown files in the root of `docs/` (`docs/*.md`).
- **Strict Exclusions:** Do **NOT** read or parse the `docs/docmd/` directory under any circumstances (this contains the built webapp assets).
